import time

def take_screenshot():
    subprocess.call(
        [
            "ffmpeg",
            "-video_size",
            "1920x1080",
            "-framerate",
            "25",
            "-f",
            "x11grab",
            "-i",
            ":0.0",
            "-vframes",
            "1",
            "screenshot.jpg",
        ]
    )
    subprocess.call(["rsync", "screenshot.jpg", "user@servername:/path/to/destination"])
    time.sleep(15)

while True:
    take_screenshot()
